results.sql: WITH matched_people AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT person_id, name FROM people WHERE name IN ('David Fincher', 'Brad Pitt')), shared_titles AS (SELECT c.title_id FROM matched_people p JOIN crew_lookup c ON c.person_id = p.person_id WHERE (p.name = 'David Fincher' AND c.category = 'director') OR (p.name = 'Brad Pitt' AND c.category IN ('actor', 'actress')) GROUP BY c.title_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.name) = 2) SELECT t.title_id, t.primary_title, t.premiered, t.genres, r.rating, r.votes, t.poster_path FROM shared_titles s JOIN titles t ON t.title_id = s.title_id AND t.type IN ('movie', 'tvMovie') LEFT JOIN ratings r ON r.title_id = t.title_id ORDER BY r.rating DESC NULLS LAST, r.votes DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100;

assertions.name: required_columns
assertions.message: All required columns are present in output

assertions.name: must_contain_ids
assertions.message: All 3 required canonical entity IDs found in results
